subject: general
question: India and Canada signed three key agreements on March 2, 2026. Which of the following is NOT one of the sectors covered by these specific MoUs?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Space Exploration and Quantum Tech.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Historic Reset:** Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** and Canadian Prime Minister **Mark Carney** held delegation-level talks at Hyderabad House, New Delhi, on **March 2, 2026**.
 
• **Agreements Signed:** Three specific Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) were exchanged covering **Critical Minerals**, **Renewable Energy**, and **Cultural Cooperation**.
 
• **Uranium Deal:** A significant 10-year, **$2 billion Uranium supply agreement** was also inked to support India's civil nuclear energy sector.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Strategic Outcomes__**

__
 
• **Trade Target:** The two nations set an ambitious bilateral trade target of **$50 billion by 2030**.
 
• **CEPA:** Both leaders agreed to accelerate the finalization of the **Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA)** by the end of 2026.
 
• **Defence Dialogue:** A new **India-Canada Defence Dialogue** was established to deepen cooperation in maritime security and military exchanges.
 
• **Other Initiatives:** While cooperation in space and quantum tech was discussed and intended (ISRO and CSA), they were part of broader strategic discussions rather than the three primary MoUs signed at this specific ceremony.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Context of the Visit__**

 
• **Diplomatic Normalization:** This visit marks a significant "reset" in ties following years of strain, moving toward a pragmatic, interest-based partnership.
 
• **Sovereign Interests:** For Canada, India represents a critical partner for diversifying trade away from the US; for India, Canada is a key source for **energy security** (Uranium, LNG) and **critical minerals** (Lithium, Cobalt) needed for the green transition.
